title: A Better Learner: How AI Could Learn Efficiently from Experience
standfirst: Train AI for what it can do after a new lesson. Published methods make that ambition concrete; SSI’s implementation remains undisclosed.
summary: A synthesis of meta-learning and test-time training, with an unfamiliar-tool example and tests that distinguish adaptation, transfer and durable competence.
claimBoundary: Literature synthesis and a stated hypothesis about SSI’s public research direction, assessed as of 3 October 2026. The invented API example and proposed tests are explanatory designs, not experimental results. This article does not identify SSI’s algorithm or establish frontier-scale learning, safety, novelty, independent reproduction or peer review.
